    The automorphism Φ of the cover induced by a weight #

    Lemma 4.13 (lem:scalar-object-values, scalar-normalization.tex): "Every scalar automorphism consequently fixes each V_X̃ up to isomorphism. Choose such isomorphisms, using the natural ones on projectives, in the direction for which the following automorphism agrees with the given scalar automorphism on the lifted projectives. Full faithfulness in Lemma 4.8 turns them into an object-fixing automorphism Φ of C̃."

    For a weight d on L, each lifted object X̃ gets a d-scaled automorphism of V_X̃ (ScAut): the natural one m ↦ d(z, x̃) m on a lifted projective x̃ (natAut), and on the other objects the components of an isomorphism V_X̃^{σ_d} ≅ V_X̃ over a finite covering algebra containing the support (exists_twistAut, from weight_twist_iso). Conjugating composition with f : X̃ → Ỹ by these gives a natural family, hence by Lemma 4.8 a morphism Φ f (Φ). Φ is linear, multiplicative, injective, and multiplies a morphism z₁ → z₂ of L by d(z₁, z₂) (Φ_proj).

                    Φ agrees with the scalar automorphism on L: it multiplies a morphism x̃₁ → x̃₂ of lifted projectives by d(x̃₁, x̃₂).
